sql: WITH g AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) + 2 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN session END) AS c FROM sess WHERE event <> 'view' GROUP BY item), hh AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS c FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 2*86400 AND event = 'order' GROUP BY item), u AS (SELECT item, sum(c) AS c FROM (SELECT item, c FROM g UNION ALL SELECT item, c FROM hh) GROUP BY item), gr AS (SELECT item, c, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c DESC, item) AS gr FROM u), gt AS (SELECT item, c FROM gr WHERE gr <= 300), x AS (SELECT t.session, gt.item, CAST(gt.c AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM sessions t CROSS JOIN gt), f AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.score FROM x WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = x.session AND z.item = x.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;

name: cos_mix_src
idea: Specific-neighbor source from the two cosine tables not yet used as sources (tb_covis14_cos, plus tb_buy_cos14 weighted double), drawn from the session's last 10 distinct prefix items with cart/order prefix items weighted triple and integer recency weights (11 - rank); cosines are scaled to integers so the sums stay exact; prefix items are excluded.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(CASE WHEN s.event <> 'view' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS w, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), li AS (SELECT session, item, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, w * (11 - rp) AS w FROM li WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), e AS (SELECT c.item, c.item2, CAST(round(c.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM tb_covis14_cos c JOIN ki ON ki.item = c.item UNION ALL SELECT b.item, b.item2, CAST(round(2 * b.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM tb_buy_cos14 b JOIN ki ON ki.item = b.item), ee AS (SELECT item, item2, sum(v) AS v FROM e GROUP BY item, item2), sc AS (SELECT lt.session, ee.item2 AS item, CAST(sum(ee.v * lt.w) AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM lt JOIN ee ON ee.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, ee.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;

name: covis3_cos
idea: Recent-trend symmetric co-visitation over only the last 3 days of history within 5 events, counted once per session, top 50 partners by cosine, to capture freshly emerging item relations for later pair features.
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, seq FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 3*86400), d AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.session, a.item, b.item AS item2 FROM h a JOIN h b ON b.session = a.session AND b.item <> a.item AND b.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5), n AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS ni FROM h GROUP BY item), p AS (SELECT item, item2, count(*) AS c FROM d GROUP BY item, item2 HAVING count(*) >= 2), q AS (SELECT p.item, p.item2, p.c, p.c / sqrt(CAST(n1.ni AS DOUBLE) * CAST(n2.ni AS DOUBLE)) AS cs FROM p JOIN n n1 ON n1.item = p.item JOIN n n2 ON n2.item = p.item2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, c, cs, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY cs DESC, c DESC, item2) AS rn FROM q) SELECT item, item2, CAST(c AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ns, CAST(cs AS DOUBLE) AS tv_cos FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;

name: v2o_rate
idea: Substitute/alternative table over 14 days of history: in sessions with 1 to 20 ordered items and at most 200 distinct items, the item was touched but not ordered while item2 was ordered, counted once per session, with the rate relative to the item's session count.
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400 GROUP BY session, item), s AS (SELECT session FROM h GROUP BY session HAVING sum(o) BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND count(*) <= 200), b AS (SELECT h.session, h.item, h.o FROM h JOIN s ON s.session = h.session), n AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS ni FROM h GROUP BY item), p AS (SELECT x.item, y.item AS item2, count(*) AS c FROM b x JOIN b y ON y.session = x.session AND y.item <> x.item AND y.o = 1 AND x.o = 0 GROUP BY x.item, y.item HAVING count(*) >= 2), q AS (SELECT p.item, p.item2, p.c, p.c / CAST(n.ni AS DOUBLE) AS rt FROM p JOIN n ON n.item = p.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, c, rt, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY c DESC, rt DESC, item2) AS rn FROM q) SELECT item, item2, CAST(c AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ns, CAST(rt AS DOUBLE) AS tv_rate FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;

name: prev_any14
idea: Reverse-direction transition table over 14 days of history: items within 2 events before the item in the same session, counted once per session, plus sessions where the item itself was then carted or ordered, so later features can tell whether a candidate typically leads into the prefix items.
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, seq, event FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400), d AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, b.item AS item2, max(CASE WHEN a.event <> 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bb FROM h a JOIN h b ON b.session = a.session AND b.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 2 AND a.seq - 1 AND b.item <> a.item GROUP BY a.session, a.item, b.item), p AS (SELECT item, item2, count(*) AS tv_ns, sum(bb) AS tv_nb FROM d GROUP BY item, item2 HAVING count(*) >= 2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, tv_ns, tv_nb, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY tv_ns DESC, tv_nb DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(tv_ns AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ns, CAST(tv_nb AS DOUBLE) AS tv_nb FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;

name: p_dwell
idea: Prefix engagement per item: total dwell time on its events (gap to the next prefix event, capped at 600 s), its events among the last 10 prefix events, and its share of prefix events.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.ts, lead(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item) AS nt, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq DESC, x.item DESC) AS rp, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session) AS n FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), d AS (SELECT session, item, CASE WHEN nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE least(nt - ts, 600) END AS dt, rp, n FROM s), g AS (SELECT session, item, CAST(sum(dt) AS DOUBLE) AS dw, CAST(sum(CASE WHEN rp <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS l10, count(*) * 1.0 / max(n) AS sh FROM d GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, g.dw AS ag_p_dwell, g.l10 AS ag_p_last10, g.sh AS ag_p_share FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;

name: last_aff
idea: Affinity of every candidate, including history items, to the prefix: 7-day co-visitation and 14-day next-item count from the last prefix item, and the strongest co-buy count from any of the last 20 prefix items.
sql: WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.seq, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS r FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item FROM lp WHERE r = 1), pi AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS ls FROM lp GROUP BY session, item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), pt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 20), cv AS (SELECT li.session, c.item2 AS item, c.tv_ns AS v FROM li JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = li.item), nx AS (SELECT li.session, n.item2 AS item, n.tv_ns AS v FROM li JOIN tb_next_any14 n ON n.item = li.item), bb AS (SELECT pt.session, b.item2 AS item, max(b.tv_ns) AS v FROM pt JOIN tb_buy2buy b ON b.item = pt.item GROUP BY pt.session, b.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(cv.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_last_covis, CAST(nx.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_last_next, CAST(bb.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_buy_max FROM cand c LEFT JOIN cv ON cv.session = c.session AND cv.item = c.item LEFT JOIN nx ON nx.session = c.session AND nx.item = c.item LEFT JOIN bb ON bb.session = c.session AND bb.item = c.item;

name: order_aff
idea: Order intent toward every candidate: strongest any-to-order count from any of the last 20 prefix items and summed view-to-order sessions from the last 5 distinct prefix items.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), ao AS (SELECT pr.session, o.item2 AS item, max(o.tv_ns) AS v FROM pr JOIN tb_any2order o ON o.item = pr.item WHERE pr.rp <= 20 GROUP BY pr.session, o.item2), vc AS (SELECT pr.session, v.item2 AS item, sum(v.tv_no) AS v FROM pr JOIN tb_view2cart v ON v.item = pr.item WHERE pr.rp <= 5 GROUP BY pr.session, v.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(ao.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_a2o_max, CAST(vc.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_v2o_last5 FROM cand c LEFT JOIN ao ON ao.session = c.session AND ao.item = c.item LEFT JOIN vc ON vc.session = c.session AND vc.item = c.item;

name: i_conv7
idea: Item conversion over the last 7 days of history: smoothed share of the item's sessions with a cart, with an order, and the share of carting sessions that also ordered.
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY session, item), a AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n, sum(c) AS nc, sum(o) AS nor, sum(c * o) AS nco FROM h GROUP BY item) SELECT item, (nc + 0.1) / (n + 10.0) AS ag_i_cart_rate, (nor + 0.03) / (n + 10.0) AS ag_i_order_rate, (nco + 1.0) / (nc + 3.0) AS ag_i_c2o FROM a;

name: i_trend
idea: Item momentum: last-day share of its 7-day history sessions, target-week prefix sessions relative to 7-day history sessions, and the share of its target-week prefixes with a cart or order.
sql: WITH hh AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts >= {S} - 86400 THEN session END) AS d1, count(DISTINCT session) AS d7 FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY item), w AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS wk, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event <> 'view' THEN session END) AS wb FROM sess GROUP BY item), k AS (SELECT item FROM hh UNION SELECT item FROM w) SELECT k.item, (coalesce(hh.d1, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(hh.d7, 0) + 7.0) AS ag_i_trend1, (coalesce(w.wk, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(hh.d7, 0) + 5.0) AS ag_i_wk_ratio, (coalesce(w.wb, 0) + 0.1) / (coalesce(w.wk, 0) + 5.0) AS ag_i_wk_buy_share FROM k LEFT JOIN hh ON hh.item = k.item LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = k.item;

name: i_age
idea: Item freshness in the last 7 days of history: age of its first and last event before the week start and age of its last order.
sql: SELECT item, CAST(max({S} - ts) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_first_age, CAST(min({S} - ts) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_last_age, CAST(min(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN {S} - ts END) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_last_order_age FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY item;

name: p_state
idea: Prefix state of each history candidate: type of its last event, whether it sits in an open cart (carted after its last order or never ordered), and the number of separate visits (runs) to it.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item) AS rn, lag(x.item) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item) AS pv FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS lc, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN seq END) AS lo, arg_max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 2 WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, rn) AS lt, sum(CASE WHEN pv IS NULL OR pv <> item THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runs FROM s GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.lt AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_last_type, CASE WHEN g.item IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN g.lc IS NOT NULL AND (g.lo IS NULL OR g.lo < g.lc) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS ag_p_open_cart, CAST(g.runs AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_runs FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;

name: link_support
idea: Breadth of support for a candidate: summed conditional co-visitation probability from the last 10 distinct prefix items (integer-exact), and the number of distinct prefix items linking to it through any accepted table and through buy tables only.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), pt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM pt), dg AS (SELECT c.item, sum(c.tv_ns) AS tot FROM tb_covis_any7 c JOIN ki ON ki.item = c.item GROUP BY c.item), cv AS (SELECT pt.session, c.item2 AS item, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * c.tv_ns / dg.tot) AS BIGINT)) AS v FROM pt JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = pt.item JOIN dg ON dg.item = pt.item GROUP BY pt.session, c.item2), lk AS (SELECT pt.session, c.item2 AS item, pt.item AS src, 0 AS b FROM pt JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, n.item2, pt.item, 0 FROM pt JOIN tb_next_any14 n ON n.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, b.item2, pt.item, 1 FROM pt JOIN tb_buy2buy b ON b.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, v.item2, pt.item, 1 FROM pt JOIN tb_view2cart v ON v.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, o.item2, pt.item, 1 FROM pt JOIN tb_any2order o ON o.item = pt.item), ln AS (SELECT session, item, count(DISTINCT src) AS n, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b = 1 THEN src END) AS nb FROM lk GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(cv.v AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_cov_cond, CAST(ln.n AS DOUBLE) AS ag_link_cnt, CAST(ln.nb AS DOUBLE) AS ag_link_buy_cnt FROM cand c LEFT JOIN cv ON cv.session = c.session AND cv.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.session = c.session AND ln.item = c.item;

name: i_repeat
idea: Item revisit behaviour over the last 7 days of history: smoothed share of the item's events directly followed by the same item, runs (separate visits) per session holding it, and share of its sessions that end on it.
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, lead(item) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS nx, lag(item) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS pv FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400), g AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN nx = item THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ns, sum(CASE WHEN nx IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ne, count(DISTINCT session) AS nsess, sum(CASE WHEN pv IS NULL OR pv <> item THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runs FROM h GROUP BY item) SELECT item, (ns + 0.5) / (n + 5.0) AS ag_i_self_rep, (runs + 1.0) / (nsess + 2.0) AS ag_i_runs_per_sess, (ne + 0.2) / (nsess + 5.0) AS ag_i_exit_rate FROM g;

name: cand_pop_rank
idea: Within-session rank of each candidate by its current-week prefix popularity and by its 7-day history order sessions, so the model compares candidates relative to their session's candidate set.
sql: WITH ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), w AS (SELECT s.item, count(DISTINCT s.session) AS v FROM sess s JOIN ci ON ci.item = s.item GROUP BY s.item), o AS (SELECT x.item, count(DISTINCT x.session) AS v FROM hist x JOIN ci ON ci.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400 AND x.event = 'order' GROUP BY x.item), j AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, coalesce(w.v, 0) AS wv, coalesce(o.v, 0) AS ov FROM cand c LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = c.item LEFT JOIN o ON o.item = c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY wv DESC, item) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_rk_wk_pop, CAST(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ov DESC, item) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_rk_h7_order FROM j;

name: last_trans_prob
idea: Normalized transition strength: conditional probability of the candidate following the last distinct prefix item (tb_next_any14) and conditional co-visitation probability from the second-to-last distinct prefix item (tb_covis_any7).
sql: WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM lp), l1 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp = 1), l2 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp = 2), ki AS (SELECT item FROM l1 UNION SELECT item FROM l2), dn AS (SELECT n.item, sum(n.tv_ns) AS tot FROM tb_next_any14 n JOIN ki ON ki.item = n.item GROUP BY n.item), dc AS (SELECT c.item, sum(c.tv_ns) AS tot FROM tb_covis_any7 c JOIN ki ON ki.item = c.item GROUP BY c.item), a AS (SELECT l1.session, n.item2 AS item, n.tv_ns / dn.tot AS v FROM l1 JOIN tb_next_any14 n ON n.item = l1.item JOIN dn ON dn.item = l1.item), b AS (SELECT l2.session, c.item2 AS item, c.tv_ns / dc.tot AS v FROM l2 JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = l2.item JOIN dc ON dc.item = l2.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, a.v AS ag_last_next_p, b.v AS ag_prev_cov_p FROM cand c LEFT JOIN a ON a.session = c.session AND a.item = c.item LEFT JOIN b ON b.session = c.session AND b.item = c.item;

name: p_cart_recency
idea: Cart recency of prefix items: seconds and events from the item's last cart to the prefix end, and its rank among the session's carted items by last cart, a direct order-intent signal.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.ts, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), e AS (SELECT session, max(ts) AS lt, max(seq) AS lq FROM s GROUP BY session), cg AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS ct, max(seq) AS cq FROM s WHERE event = 'cart' GROUP BY session, item), cr AS (SELECT cg.session, cg.item, e.lt - cg.ct AS age, e.lq - cg.cq AS ev, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cg.session ORDER BY cg.cq DESC, cg.item) AS rk FROM cg JOIN e ON e.session = cg.session) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(cr.age AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_cart_age, CAST(cr.ev AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_cart_evts, CAST(cr.rk AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_cart_rank FROM cand c LEFT JOIN cr ON cr.session = c.session AND cr.item = c.item;

name: p_rel_time
idea: Session-relative timing of prefix items: time of the item's last occurrence as a fraction of the prefix duration, and the fraction of the prefix duration spanned between its first and last occurrence.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.ts FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), e AS (SELECT session, min(ts) AS ft, max(ts) AS lt FROM s GROUP BY session), g AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS it, min(ts) AS ift FROM s GROUP BY session, item), gg AS (SELECT g.session, g.item, CASE WHEN e.lt > e.ft THEN (g.it - e.ft) * 1.0 / (e.lt - e.ft) END AS rt, CASE WHEN e.lt > e.ft THEN (g.it - g.ift) * 1.0 / (e.lt - e.ft) END AS sp FROM g JOIN e ON e.session = g.session) SELECT c.session, c.item, gg.rt AS ag_p_rel_time, gg.sp AS ag_p_span_share FROM cand c LEFT JOIN gg ON gg.session = c.session AND gg.item = c.item;

name: time_pop
idea: Time-local item popularity around the moment of the session: distinct sessions holding the item on the same day of the week as the session's last prefix event, and its smoothed share of all active sessions in the 3 hourly buckets up to that event (prefixes plus the last history day).
sql: WITH ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), sl AS (SELECT s.session, max(s.ts) AS lt FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session), sb AS (SELECT session, CAST(floor((lt - {S}) / 86400.0) AS BIGINT) AS d, CAST(floor((lt - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT) AS hb FROM sl), ae AS (SELECT session, item, ts FROM sess UNION ALL SELECT session, item, ts FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 86400), ie AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, CAST(floor((a.ts - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT) AS h FROM ae a JOIN ci ON ci.item = a.item), ih AS (SELECT item, h, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM ie GROUP BY item, h), idy AS (SELECT item, CAST(floor(h / 24.0) AS BIGINT) AS d, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM ie GROUP BY item, CAST(floor(h / 24.0) AS BIGINT)), th AS (SELECT CAST(floor((ts - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT) AS h, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM ae GROUP BY CAST(floor((ts - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT)), sh AS (SELECT sb.session, sb.hb - v.k AS h FROM sb CROSS JOIN (VALUES (0), (1), (2)) v(k)), hc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(ih.n) AS n FROM cand c JOIN sh ON sh.session = c.session JOIN ih ON ih.item = c.item AND ih.h = sh.h GROUP BY c.session, c.item), tt AS (SELECT sh.session, sum(th.n) AS n FROM sh JOIN th ON th.h = sh.h GROUP BY sh.session) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(coalesce(idy.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_day_sess, (coalesce(hc.n, 0) + 0.1) * 100000.0 / (coalesce(tt.n, 0) + 100.0) AS ag_i_hr3_share FROM cand c JOIN sb ON sb.session = c.session LEFT JOIN idy ON idy.item = c.item AND idy.d = sb.d LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.session = c.session AND hc.item = c.item LEFT JOIN tt ON tt.session = c.session;

name: s_state
idea: Session purchase state: number of open carts (items carted after their last order or never ordered), the gap in seconds between the last two prefix events, and the position of the prefix end inside the week.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.ts, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS lc, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN seq END) AS lo FROM s GROUP BY session, item), oc AS (SELECT session, sum(CASE WHEN lc IS NOT NULL AND (lo IS NULL OR lo < lc) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n FROM g GROUP BY session), o AS (SELECT session, ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq DESC, item DESC, event DESC) AS r FROM s), lg AS (SELECT session, max(CASE WHEN r = 1 THEN ts END) - max(CASE WHEN r = 2 THEN ts END) AS gap, max(CASE WHEN r = 1 THEN ts END) AS lt FROM o GROUP BY session) SELECT t.session, CAST(oc.n AS DOUBLE) AS ag_s_open_carts, CAST(lg.gap AS DOUBLE) AS ag_s_last_gap, (lg.lt - {S}) / 86400.0 AS ag_s_week_pos FROM sessions t LEFT JOIN oc ON oc.session = t.session LEFT JOIN lg ON lg.session = t.session;

name: i_wk_conv
idea: Current-week item conversion from all target-week prefixes: smoothed share of prefixes that carted the item and also ordered it, and smoothed share of the item's prefixes with an order.
sql: WITH g AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM sess GROUP BY session, item), a AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n, sum(c) AS nc, sum(o) AS nor, sum(c * o) AS nco FROM g GROUP BY item) SELECT item, (nco + 0.5) / (nc + 2.0) AS ag_i_wk_c2o, (nor + 0.02) / (n + 5.0) AS ag_i_wk_order_rate FROM a;

name: wk_last_trans
idea: Current-week normalized transitions from the last prefix item to every candidate, prefix items included: share of target-week prefixes holding the last item where the candidate follows within 3 events and within 20 events.
sql: WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS r FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item FROM lp WHERE r = 1), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), dn AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS tot FROM a GROUP BY item), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.seq <= a.seq + 3 THEN y.session END) AS c3, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c20 FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq + 1 AND a.seq + 20 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, pr.dst AS item, pr.c3, pr.c20, dn.tot FROM li JOIN pr ON pr.src = li.item JOIN dn ON dn.item = li.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, sc.c3 * 1.0 / (sc.tot + 1.0) AS ag_wk_last_next3_p, sc.c20 * 1.0 / (sc.tot + 1.0) AS ag_wk_last_next20_p FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;

name: cart_order_aff
idea: Order affinity anchored on prefix carts: co-buy count from the most recently carted prefix item (tb_buy2buy) and summed any-to-order sessions from the last 10 carted prefix items (tb_any2order), for every candidate.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), cg AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS cq FROM s WHERE event = 'cart' GROUP BY session, item), cr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY cq DESC, item) AS rk FROM cg), lc AS (SELECT session, item FROM cr WHERE rk = 1), bl AS (SELECT lc.session, b.item2 AS item, b.tv_ns AS v FROM lc JOIN tb_buy2buy b ON b.item = lc.item), ao AS (SELECT cr.session, o.item2 AS item, sum(o.tv_ns) AS v FROM cr JOIN tb_any2order o ON o.item = cr.item WHERE cr.rk <= 10 GROUP BY cr.session, o.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(bl.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_lastcart_b2b, CAST(ao.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cart_a2o_sum FROM cand c LEFT JOIN bl ON bl.session = c.session AND bl.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ao ON ao.session = c.session AND ao.item = c.item;

name: cos_aff
idea: Specific-neighbor affinity for every candidate, history items included: the strongest 14-day and 3-day co-visitation cosine from the last 5 distinct prefix items, and the strongest buy cosine from the last 20, so rare but specific links are not drowned by popular hubs.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), p5 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 5), p20 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 20), a AS (SELECT p5.session, c.item2 AS item, max(c.tv_cos) AS v FROM p5 JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = p5.item GROUP BY p5.session, c.item2), b AS (SELECT p5.session, c.item2 AS item, max(c.tv_cos) AS v FROM p5 JOIN tb_covis3_cos c ON c.item = p5.item GROUP BY p5.session, c.item2), d AS (SELECT p20.session, c.item2 AS item, max(c.tv_cos) AS v FROM p20 JOIN tb_buy_cos14 c ON c.item = p20.item GROUP BY p20.session, c.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, a.v AS ag_cos14_max, b.v AS ag_cos3_max, d.v AS ag_bcos_max FROM cand c LEFT JOIN a ON a.session = c.session AND a.item = c.item LEFT JOIN b ON b.session = c.session AND b.item = c.item LEFT JOIN d ON d.session = c.session AND d.item = c.item;

name: sub_prev
idea: Substitute and lead-in signals: the strongest rate at which the candidate was ordered instead of one of the last 10 distinct prefix items that were not ordered (tb_v2o_rate), and how often the candidate typically comes right before the last distinct prefix item (tb_prev_any14).
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), pi AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS ls, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM s GROUP BY session, item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, o, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), su AS (SELECT pr.session, v.item2 AS item, max(v.tv_rate) AS v FROM pr JOIN tb_v2o_rate v ON v.item = pr.item WHERE pr.rp <= 10 AND pr.o = 0 GROUP BY pr.session, v.item2), l1 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp = 1), pv AS (SELECT l1.session, p.item2 AS item, p.tv_ns AS v FROM l1 JOIN tb_prev_any14 p ON p.item = l1.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, su.v AS ag_sub_max, CAST(pv.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_prev_last FROM cand c LEFT JOIN su ON su.session = c.session AND su.item = c.item LEFT JOIN pv ON pv.session = c.session AND pv.item = c.item;

name: p_cart_dyn
idea: Behaviour after carting a prefix item: views of the item after its first cart (reconsideration), other items carted after its last cart, and distinct other items touched after its last cart, to tell items about to be ordered from abandoned carts.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, min(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS fcq, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS lcq FROM s GROUP BY session, item HAVING max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1), va AS (SELECT g.session, g.item, sum(CASE WHEN s.event = 'view' AND s.seq > g.fcq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nv FROM g JOIN s ON s.session = g.session AND s.item = g.item GROUP BY g.session, g.item), af AS (SELECT g.session, g.item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.event = 'cart' THEN s.item END) AS nc, count(DISTINCT s.item) AS ni FROM g JOIN s ON s.session = g.session AND s.item <> g.item AND s.seq > g.lcq GROUP BY g.session, g.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(va.nv AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_view_after_cart, CASE WHEN g.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(af.nc, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_p_carts_after, CASE WHEN g.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(af.ni, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_p_items_after_cart FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item LEFT JOIN va ON va.session = c.session AND va.item = c.item LEFT JOIN af ON af.session = c.session AND af.item = c.item;

name: p_wscore
idea: Single recency-weighted interaction score of each prefix item, type weights view 1, cart 6, order 3, decayed once by event position from the prefix end and once by time from the prefix end (10-minute scale), with integer-exact sums.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.event, x.ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq DESC, x.item DESC, x.event DESC) AS rp, max(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session) AS lt FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), w AS (SELECT session, item, CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 6 WHEN event = 'order' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END AS tw, rp, lt - ts AS age FROM s), g AS (SELECT session, item, sum(CAST(round(tw * 1000000.0 / rp) AS BIGINT)) AS ws, sum(CAST(round(tw * 1000000.0 / (1.0 + age / 600.0)) AS BIGINT)) AS td FROM w GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.ws AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_p_wsum, CAST(g.td AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_p_tdec FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;

name: i_cart_dyn
idea: Item purchase dynamics over the last 7 days of history: smoothed share of carting sessions with repeated carts, average views before the first cart, and average capped seconds from first cart to first order.
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, seq, ts, event FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400), g AS (SELECT session, item, min(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS fcq, min(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN ts END) AS fct, min(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN ts END) AS fot, sum(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nc FROM h GROUP BY session, item), vb AS (SELECT g.session, g.item, count(*) AS nv FROM g JOIN h ON h.session = g.session AND h.item = g.item AND h.event = 'view' AND h.seq < g.fcq GROUP BY g.session, g.item), a AS (SELECT g.item, sum(CASE WHEN g.fcq IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ncs, sum(CASE WHEN g.nc >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nrc, sum(coalesce(vb.nv, 0)) AS nvb, sum(CASE WHEN g.fot >= g.fct THEN least(g.fot - g.fct, 86400) ELSE 0 END) AS dt, sum(CASE WHEN g.fot >= g.fct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nco FROM g LEFT JOIN vb ON vb.session = g.session AND vb.item = g.item GROUP BY g.item) SELECT item, (nrc + 0.2) / (ncs + 2.0) AS ag_i_recart, (nvb + 2.0) / (ncs + 1.0) AS ag_i_view_pre_cart, (dt + 3600.0) / (nco + 1.0) AS ag_i_c2o_sec FROM a;

name: wk_cos_aff
idea: Current-week co-visitation cosine (within 5 events in target-week prefixes, pair prefixes divided by the square root of both items' prefix counts) from the last 5 distinct prefix items to every candidate: the maximum and an integer-exact recency-weighted sum, so specific fresh links are not drowned by popular hubs.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, rp FROM pr WHERE rp <= 5), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), pc AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), ns AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM a GROUP BY item), ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), nd AS (SELECT s.item, count(DISTINCT s.session) AS n FROM sess s JOIN ci ON ci.item = s.item GROUP BY s.item), q AS (SELECT lt.session, pc.dst AS item, lt.rp, pc.c / sqrt(CAST(ns.n AS DOUBLE) * CAST(nd.n AS DOUBLE)) AS cs FROM lt JOIN pc ON pc.src = lt.item JOIN ns ON ns.item = lt.item JOIN nd ON nd.item = pc.dst), g AS (SELECT session, item, max(cs) AS mx, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * cs) AS BIGINT) * (6 - rp)) AS sm FROM q GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, g.mx AS ag_wk_cos_max, CAST(g.sm AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_wk_cos_wsum FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;

name: cos14_wsum_rank
idea: Recency- and type-weighted sum of 14-day co-visitation cosine from the last 10 distinct prefix items to every candidate (integer-exact), its share of the session's total over candidates and the candidate's within-session rank by it, giving a session-normalized affinity signal.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(CASE WHEN s.event <> 'view' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS w, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), li AS (SELECT session, item, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, w * (11 - rp) AS w FROM li WHERE rp <= 10), sc AS (SELECT lt.session, c.item2 AS item, sum(CAST(round(c.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT) * lt.w) AS v FROM lt JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, c.item2), j AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sc.v FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_cos14_wsum, CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(v AS DOUBLE) / CAST(sum(v) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_cos14_share, CAST(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY coalesce(v, -1) DESC, item) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cos14_rk FROM j;

name: ctx2_next
idea: Second-order transitions: in 7-day history sessions where the second-to-last distinct prefix item is followed within 2 events by the last distinct prefix item, the items seen within 3 events afterwards (returning to the earlier item allowed), as count and conditional probability.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), kp AS (SELECT a.session, a.item AS ia, b.item AS ib FROM pr a JOIN pr b ON b.session = a.session AND a.rp = 2 AND b.rp = 1), pk AS (SELECT DISTINCT ia, ib FROM kp), h AS (SELECT session, item, seq FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400), x AS (SELECT DISTINCT xx.session, xx.seq, pk.ia, pk.ib FROM h xx JOIN pk ON pk.ib = xx.item JOIN h y ON y.session = xx.session AND y.item = pk.ia AND y.seq BETWEEN xx.seq - 2 AND xx.seq - 1), tt AS (SELECT ia, ib, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM x GROUP BY ia, ib), f AS (SELECT x.ia, x.ib, z.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT z.session) AS c FROM x JOIN h z ON z.session = x.session AND z.seq BETWEEN x.seq + 1 AND x.seq + 3 AND z.item <> x.ib GROUP BY x.ia, x.ib, z.item), sc AS (SELECT kp.session, f.dst AS item, f.c, tt.n FROM kp JOIN f ON f.ia = kp.ia AND f.ib = kp.ib JOIN tt ON tt.ia = kp.ia AND tt.ib = kp.ib) SELECT c.session, c.item, sc.c * 1.0 / (sc.n + 1.0) AS ag_ctx2_next_p, CAST(sc.c AS DOUBLE) AS ag_ctx2_next_n FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;

name: p_cond_rates
idea: History-conditioned intent of prefix items: among 7-day history sessions that reached as many views of the item (capped at 5) without carting, the smoothed share that then carted it, and among sessions with that many views the share that viewed it once more.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), pv AS (SELECT session, item, least(sum(CASE WHEN event = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 5) AS k FROM s GROUP BY session, item), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM pv), h AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), fc AS (SELECT session, item, min(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS fcq FROM h GROUP BY session, item), g AS (SELECT h.session, h.item, sum(CASE WHEN h.event = 'view' AND (fc.fcq IS NULL OR h.seq < fc.fcq) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nvb, sum(CASE WHEN h.event = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nv, max(CASE WHEN fc.fcq IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cc FROM h JOIN fc ON fc.session = h.session AND fc.item = h.item GROUP BY h.session, h.item), kk AS (SELECT k FROM (VALUES (0), (1), (2), (3), (4), (5)) v(k)), r AS (SELECT g.item, kk.k, sum(CASE WHEN g.nvb >= kk.k THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb, sum(CASE WHEN g.cc = 1 AND g.nvb >= kk.k THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nc, sum(CASE WHEN g.nv >= kk.k THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS na, sum(CASE WHEN g.nv >= kk.k + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr FROM g CROSS JOIN kk GROUP BY g.item, kk.k) SELECT c.session, c.item, CASE WHEN pv.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(r.nc, 0) + 0.1) / (coalesce(r.nb, 0) + 5.0) END AS ag_p_cond_cart, CASE WHEN pv.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(r.nr, 0) + 0.5) / (coalesce(r.na, 0) + 5.0) END AS ag_p_cond_revisit FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pv ON pv.session = c.session AND pv.item = c.item LEFT JOIN r ON r.item = pv.item AND r.k = pv.k;

name: p_cart_surv
idea: History survival rates for prefix items: among 7-day history sessions that carted the item and lasted as many events past the cart without ordering (bucketed like the prefix), the smoothed share that still ordered it; and among history sessions with at least as many views of the item (capped at 5), the smoothed share that ordered it.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), e AS (SELECT session, max(seq) AS lq FROM s GROUP BY session), pg AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS lcq, sum(CASE WHEN event = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nv FROM s GROUP BY session, item), pk AS (SELECT pg.session, pg.item, CASE WHEN pg.lcq IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.lq - pg.lcq >= 16 THEN 16 WHEN e.lq - pg.lcq >= 8 THEN 8 WHEN e.lq - pg.lcq >= 4 THEN 4 WHEN e.lq - pg.lcq >= 2 THEN 2 WHEN e.lq - pg.lcq >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS kc, least(pg.nv, 5) AS kv FROM pg JOIN e ON e.session = pg.session), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM pk), h AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), g AS (SELECT session, item, min(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS fcq, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN seq END) AS loq, sum(CASE WHEN event = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nv FROM h GROUP BY session, item), hs AS (SELECT DISTINCT session FROM g WHERE fcq IS NOT NULL), hl AS (SELECT y.session, max(y.seq) AS ml FROM hist y JOIN hs ON hs.session = y.session WHERE y.ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY y.session), kcs AS (SELECT k FROM (VALUES (0), (1), (2), (4), (8), (16)) v(k)), kvs AS (SELECT k FROM (VALUES (0), (1), (2), (3), (4), (5)) v(k)), rc AS (SELECT g.item, kcs.k, sum(CASE WHEN g.loq > g.fcq + kcs.k OR (g.loq IS NULL AND hl.ml >= g.fcq + kcs.k) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb, sum(CASE WHEN g.loq > g.fcq + kcs.k THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr FROM g JOIN hl ON hl.session = g.session CROSS JOIN kcs WHERE g.fcq IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.item, kcs.k), rv AS (SELECT g.item, kvs.k, sum(CASE WHEN g.nv >= kvs.k THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb, sum(CASE WHEN g.nv >= kvs.k AND g.loq IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr FROM g CROSS JOIN kvs GROUP BY g.item, kvs.k) SELECT c.session, c.item, CASE WHEN pk.kc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(rc.nr, 0) + 0.3) / (coalesce(rc.nb, 0) + 2.0) END AS ag_p_cart_surv, CASE WHEN pk.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(rv.nr, 0) + 0.03) / (coalesce(rv.nb, 0) + 5.0) END AS ag_p_view_order FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pk ON pk.session = c.session AND pk.item = c.item LEFT JOIN rc ON rc.item = pk.item AND rc.k = pk.kc LEFT JOIN rv ON rv.item = pk.item AND rv.k = pk.kv;

name: alt_after
idea: Alternative shopping after a prefix item: number of its 14-day cosine neighbors touched later in the prefix and the strongest such cosine, and for carted items the neighbors carted or ordered after its last cart, to spot items replaced by substitutes.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), pi AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS ls, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS lcq FROM s GROUP BY session, item), pp AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, b.item AS oi, CASE WHEN b.ls > a.ls THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS aft, CASE WHEN a.lcq IS NOT NULL AND b.lcq > a.lcq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bc FROM pi a JOIN pi b ON b.session = a.session AND b.item <> a.item AND (b.ls > a.ls OR b.lcq > a.lcq)), nb AS (SELECT pp.session, pp.item, sum(pp.aft) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pp.aft = 1 THEN c.tv_cos END) AS mc, sum(pp.bc) AS nbc FROM pp JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = pp.item AND c.item2 = pp.oi GROUP BY pp.session, pp.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CASE WHEN pi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(nb.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_alt_after_n, CASE WHEN pi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(nb.mc, 0.0) AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_alt_after_max, CASE WHEN pi.lcq IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(nb.nbc, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_cart_alt_buy FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pi ON pi.session = c.session AND pi.item = c.item LEFT JOIN nb ON nb.session = c.session AND nb.item = c.item;

name: link_buy_share
idea: Purchase quality of the links to a candidate: smoothed share of 14-day next-item transitions from the last prefix item that ended in a cart or order, the same share for 7-day co-visitation summed over the last 5 distinct prefix items, and the share of any-to-order links from the last 20 where the source was carted.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), l1 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp = 1), p5 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 5), p20 AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 20), nx AS (SELECT l1.session, n.item2 AS item, (n.tv_nb + 0.5) / (n.tv_ns + 2.0) AS v FROM l1 JOIN tb_next_any14 n ON n.item = l1.item), cv AS (SELECT p5.session, c.item2 AS item, (sum(c.tv_nb) + 0.5) / (sum(c.tv_ns) + 2.0) AS v FROM p5 JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = p5.item GROUP BY p5.session, c.item2), ao AS (SELECT p20.session, o.item2 AS item, (sum(o.tv_nc) + 0.2) / (sum(o.tv_ns) + 2.0) AS v FROM p20 JOIN tb_any2order o ON o.item = p20.item GROUP BY p20.session, o.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, nx.v AS ag_next_buy_sh, cv.v AS ag_cov_buy_sh, ao.v AS ag_a2o_cart_sh FROM cand c LEFT JOIN nx ON nx.session = c.session AND nx.item = c.item LEFT JOIN cv ON cv.session = c.session AND cv.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ao ON ao.session = c.session AND ao.item = c.item;

name: p_burst
idea: Session-relative recency of prefix items: age of the last occurrence divided by the session's median inter-event gap, and how many activity bursts (gaps over 30 minutes) separate it from the prefix end.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event, x.ts FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), o AS (SELECT session, item, seq, event, ts, ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item, event) AS gap FROM s), b AS (SELECT session, item, ts, gap, sum(CASE WHEN gap > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item, event ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS bid FROM o), se AS (SELECT session, max(ts) AS lt, median(gap) AS mg, max(bid) AS lb FROM b GROUP BY session), gi AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS it, max(bid) AS ib FROM b GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CASE WHEN gi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (se.lt - gi.it) / (coalesce(se.mg, 0) + 1.0) END AS ag_p_age_norm, CASE WHEN gi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(se.lb - gi.ib AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_p_bursts_back FROM cand c LEFT JOIN gi ON gi.session = c.session AND gi.item = c.item LEFT JOIN se ON se.session = c.session;

name: cart_cos_aff
idea: Cart-anchored specific affinity for every candidate: recency-weighted integer-exact sums of buy cosine and 14-day co-visitation cosine from the last 10 carted or ordered prefix items, and the strongest co-order count from them.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), cg AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS cq FROM s WHERE event <> 'view' GROUP BY session, item), cr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY cq DESC, item) AS rk FROM cg), ct AS (SELECT session, item, 11 - rk AS w FROM cr WHERE rk <= 10), bs AS (SELECT ct.session, b.item2 AS item, sum(CAST(round(b.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT) * ct.w) AS v, max(b.tv_no) AS mo FROM ct JOIN tb_buy_cos14 b ON b.item = ct.item GROUP BY ct.session, b.item2), cs AS (SELECT ct.session, c.item2 AS item, sum(CAST(round(c.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT) * ct.w) AS v FROM ct JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = ct.item GROUP BY ct.session, c.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(bs.v AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_cart_bcos_wsum, CAST(bs.mo AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cart_coord_max, CAST(cs.v AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_cart_cos14_wsum FROM cand c LEFT JOIN bs ON bs.session = c.session AND bs.item = c.item LEFT JOIN cs ON cs.session = c.session AND cs.item = c.item;

name: knn_wk
idea: Session kNN over target-week prefixes: other prefixes sharing at least 2 of the session's last 10 distinct items (items held by at most 3000 prefixes), summing the overlap size over neighbors that hold the candidate and over neighbors that carted or ordered it.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), si AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), df AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM si GROUP BY item), kq AS (SELECT si.session, si.item FROM si JOIN df ON df.item = si.item WHERE df.n <= 3000), nb AS (SELECT lt.session, kq.session AS ns, count(*) AS ov FROM lt JOIN kq ON kq.item = lt.item AND kq.session <> lt.session GROUP BY lt.session, kq.session HAVING count(*) >= 2), nq AS (SELECT DISTINCT ns FROM nb), ni AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, max(CASE WHEN x.event <> 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b FROM sess x JOIN nq ON nq.ns = x.session GROUP BY x.session, x.item), sc AS (SELECT nb.session, ni.item, sum(nb.ov) AS v, sum(nb.ov * ni.b) AS vb FROM nb JOIN ni ON ni.session = nb.ns GROUP BY nb.session, ni.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(sc.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_knn_wk_sum, CAST(sc.vb AS DOUBLE) AS ag_knn_wk_buy FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;

name: knn_hist
idea: Session kNN over 7-day history: history sessions sharing at least 2 of the session's last 10 distinct items (items in at most 5000 sessions), overlap-weighted count of neighbors that carted or ordered the candidate, and the session-normalized share of neighbor overlap that ordered it.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), si AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), df AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM si GROUP BY item), kq AS (SELECT si.session, si.item FROM si JOIN df ON df.item = si.item WHERE df.n <= 5000), nb AS (SELECT lt.session, kq.session AS ns, count(*) AS ov FROM lt JOIN kq ON kq.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, kq.session HAVING count(*) >= 2), tot AS (SELECT session, sum(ov) AS t FROM nb GROUP BY session), nq AS (SELECT DISTINCT ns FROM nb), ni AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, max(CASE WHEN x.event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist x JOIN nq ON nq.ns = x.session WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400 AND x.event <> 'view' GROUP BY x.session, x.item), sc AS (SELECT nb.session, ni.item, sum(nb.ov) AS vb, sum(nb.ov * ni.o) AS vo FROM nb JOIN ni ON ni.session = nb.ns GROUP BY nb.session, ni.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(sc.vb AS DOUBLE) AS ag_knn_h_buy, CASE WHEN sc.vo IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (sc.vo + 0.1) / (tot.t + 2.0) END AS ag_knn_h_ord_sh FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.session = c.session;

name: i_buy_trend
idea: Item purchase momentum: smoothed share of the item's 7-day order sessions and cart sessions that fall in the last 2 days, and target-week carting prefixes relative to 7-day history cart sessions.
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'order' AND ts >= {S} - 2*86400 THEN session END) AS o2, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN session END) AS o7, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'cart' AND ts >= {S} - 2*86400 THEN session END) AS c2, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN session END) AS c7 FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 AND event <> 'view' GROUP BY item), w AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS wc FROM sess WHERE event <> 'view' GROUP BY item), k AS (SELECT item FROM h UNION SELECT item FROM w) SELECT k.item, (coalesce(h.o2, 0) + 0.6) / (coalesce(h.o7, 0) + 2.0) AS ag_i_ord_tr2, (coalesce(h.c2, 0) + 0.6) / (coalesce(h.c7, 0) + 2.0) AS ag_i_cart_tr2, (coalesce(w.wc, 0) + 0.5) / (coalesce(h.c7, 0) + 3.0) AS ag_i_wk_buy_ratio FROM k LEFT JOIN h ON h.item = k.item LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = k.item;

name: rev_rank
idea: Reciprocal link strength seen from the candidate: best rank of the last 5 distinct prefix items in the candidate's own 14-day cosine neighbor list, rank of the last prefix item among the candidate's typical predecessors, and best rank of the last 20 prefix items in the candidate's buy-cosine list.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), cr AS (SELECT c.item, c.item2, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.item ORDER BY c.tv_cos DESC, c.tv_ns DESC, c.item2) AS rk FROM tb_covis14_cos c JOIN ci ON ci.item = c.item), pv AS (SELECT p.item, p.item2, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.item ORDER BY p.tv_ns DESC, p.tv_nb DESC, p.item2) AS rk FROM tb_prev_any14 p JOIN ci ON ci.item = p.item), bc AS (SELECT b.item, b.item2, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.item ORDER BY b.tv_cos DESC, b.tv_ns DESC, b.item2) AS rk FROM tb_buy_cos14 b JOIN ci ON ci.item = b.item), a AS (SELECT pr.session, cr.item, min(cr.rk) AS v FROM pr JOIN cr ON cr.item2 = pr.item WHERE pr.rp <= 5 GROUP BY pr.session, cr.item), b AS (SELECT pr.session, pv.item, min(pv.rk) AS v FROM pr JOIN pv ON pv.item2 = pr.item WHERE pr.rp = 1 GROUP BY pr.session, pv.item), d AS (SELECT pr.session, bc.item, min(bc.rk) AS v FROM pr JOIN bc ON bc.item2 = pr.item WHERE pr.rp <= 20 GROUP BY pr.session, bc.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(a.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_rev_cos_rk, CAST(b.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_rev_prev_rk, CAST(d.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_rev_bcos_rk FROM cand c LEFT JOIN a ON a.session = c.session AND a.item = c.item LEFT JOIN b ON b.session = c.session AND b.item = c.item LEFT JOIN d ON d.session = c.session AND d.item = c.item;

name: p_first
idea: Landing intent of prefix items: event position of the item's first occurrence from the prefix start (1 = the session's entry item) and seconds from the prefix start to its first occurrence.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.ts, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), o AS (SELECT session, item, ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item, event) AS rn, min(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS ft FROM s), g AS (SELECT session, item, min(rn) AS fp, min(ts) - min(ft) AS fg FROM o GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.fp AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_first_pos, CAST(g.fg AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_first_gap FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;

name: p_rev_surv
idea: History revisit survival for prefix items: among 7-day history occurrences of the item followed by at least as many other events as the prefix has after its last occurrence (bucketed 0/1/2/4/8/16), the smoothed share where the item came back, and the share where it came back with a cart or order.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), e AS (SELECT session, max(seq) AS lq FROM s GROUP BY session), pg AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, e.lq - max(s.seq) AS g FROM s JOIN e ON e.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item, e.lq), pk AS (SELECT session, item, CASE WHEN g >= 16 THEN 16 WHEN g >= 8 THEN 8 WHEN g >= 4 THEN 4 WHEN g >= 2 THEN 2 WHEN g >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k FROM pg), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM pk), h AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, lead(x.seq) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session, x.item ORDER BY x.seq, x.event) AS nx, lead(x.event) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session, x.item ORDER BY x.seq, x.event) AS ne FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), hs AS (SELECT DISTINCT session FROM h), hl AS (SELECT y.session, max(y.seq) AS ml FROM hist y JOIN hs ON hs.session = y.session WHERE y.ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY y.session), o AS (SELECT h.item, CASE WHEN h.nx IS NOT NULL THEN least(h.nx - h.seq - 1, 16) ELSE least(hl.ml - h.seq, 16) END AS sv, CASE WHEN h.nx IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rt, CASE WHEN h.nx IS NOT NULL AND h.ne <> 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rb FROM h JOIN hl ON hl.session = h.session), oa AS (SELECT item, sv, count(*) AS n, sum(rt) AS nr, sum(rb) AS nrb FROM o GROUP BY item, sv), kk AS (SELECT k FROM (VALUES (0), (1), (2), (4), (8), (16)) v(k)), r AS (SELECT oa.item, kk.k, sum(oa.n) AS nb, sum(oa.nr) AS nr, sum(oa.nrb) AS nrb FROM oa CROSS JOIN kk WHERE oa.sv >= kk.k GROUP BY oa.item, kk.k) SELECT c.session, c.item, CASE WHEN pk.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(r.nr, 0) + 0.3) / (coalesce(r.nb, 0) + 2.0) END AS ag_p_rev_surv, CASE WHEN pk.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(r.nrb, 0) + 0.05) / (coalesce(r.nb, 0) + 2.0) END AS ag_p_rev_buy_surv FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pk ON pk.session = c.session AND pk.item = c.item LEFT JOIN r ON r.item = pk.item AND r.k = pk.k;

name: typed_next
idea: Event-type-aware transitions: in 14-day history, after an event of the same type (view, cart or order) on the last prefix item, the share of such sessions where the candidate follows within 5 events, and the share where it follows with a cart or order.
sql: WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.event, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item, s.event) AS r FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, event FROM lp WHERE r = 1), ke AS (SELECT DISTINCT item, event FROM li), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.event, x.seq FROM hist x JOIN ke ON ke.item = x.item AND ke.event = x.event WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 14*86400), dn AS (SELECT item, event, count(DISTINCT session) AS tot FROM a GROUP BY item, event), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, a.event AS se, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.event <> 'view' THEN y.session END) AS cb FROM a JOIN hist y ON y.session = a.session AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq + 1 AND a.seq + 5 AND y.item <> a.item WHERE y.ts >= {S} - 14*86400 GROUP BY a.item, a.event, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, pr.dst AS item, pr.c, pr.cb, dn.tot FROM li JOIN pr ON pr.src = li.item AND pr.se = li.event JOIN dn ON dn.item = li.item AND dn.event = li.event) SELECT c.session, c.item, sc.c * 1.0 / (sc.tot + 2.0) AS ag_typed_next_p, (sc.cb + 0.1) * 1.0 / (sc.tot + 2.0) AS ag_typed_next_buy_p FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;

name: entry_aff
idea: Affinity to the session's anchor intents rather than its recent tail: 14-day co-visitation cosine from the entry (first) prefix item and from the most interacted prefix item, and buy cosine from the entry item, for every candidate.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), pi AS (SELECT session, item, min(seq) AS fs, max(seq) AS ls, count(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY session, item), fr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY fs, item) AS r FROM pi), f1 AS (SELECT session, item FROM fr WHERE r = 1), mr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY n DESC, ls DESC, item) AS r FROM pi), m1 AS (SELECT session, item FROM mr WHERE r = 1), a AS (SELECT f1.session, c.item2 AS item, c.tv_cos AS v FROM f1 JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = f1.item), b AS (SELECT m1.session, c.item2 AS item, c.tv_cos AS v FROM m1 JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = m1.item), d AS (SELECT f1.session, bc.item2 AS item, bc.tv_cos AS v FROM f1 JOIN tb_buy_cos14 bc ON bc.item = f1.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, a.v AS ag_entry_cos14, b.v AS ag_main_cos14, d.v AS ag_entry_bcos FROM cand c LEFT JOIN a ON a.session = c.session AND a.item = c.item LEFT JOIN b ON b.session = c.session AND b.item = c.item LEFT JOIN d ON d.session = c.session AND d.item = c.item;

name: p_last_dwell
idea: Engagement at the most recent visit of each prefix item: capped seconds spent on its last occurrence before the next prefix event (-1 if it is the final event) and the longest single dwell on it, separating a quick bounce from a deep look.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item, x.event) AS rn, lead(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item, x.event) AS nt FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), d AS (SELECT session, item, rn, CASE WHEN nt IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE least(nt - ts, 600) END AS dt FROM s), g AS (SELECT session, item, arg_max(dt, rn) AS ld, max(dt) AS md FROM d GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.ld AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_last_dwell, CAST(g.md AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_max_dwell FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;

name: wk_cocart
idea: Current-week basket affinity anchored on the session's carted or ordered prefix items: recency-weighted count of target-week prefixes that carted or ordered both an anchor and the candidate, and the same count where the candidate was ordered.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), cg AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS cq FROM s WHERE event <> 'view' GROUP BY session, item), cr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY cq DESC, item) AS rk FROM cg), ct AS (SELECT session, item, 11 - rk AS w FROM cr WHERE rk <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM ct), bb AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM sess WHERE event <> 'view' GROUP BY session, item), a AS (SELECT bb.session, bb.item FROM bb JOIN ki ON ki.item = bb.item), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(*) AS c, sum(y.o) AS co FROM a JOIN bb y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT ct.session, pr.dst AS item, sum(pr.c * ct.w) AS v, sum(pr.co * ct.w) AS vo FROM ct JOIN pr ON pr.src = ct.item GROUP BY ct.session, pr.dst) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(sc.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wk_cocart, CAST(sc.vo AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wk_coorder FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;

name: wk_after_buy
idea: Current-week directed purchase follow-through: for the last 3 distinct prefix items, the share of target-week prefixes holding the item in which the candidate was carted or ordered (and ordered only) after the item's first occurrence, recency-weighted and integer-exact.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, rp FROM pr WHERE rp <= 3), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, min(x.seq) AS fq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item GROUP BY x.session, x.item), dn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS tot FROM a GROUP BY item), bb AS (SELECT session, item, seq, event FROM sess WHERE event <> 'view'), pc AS (SELECT a.item AS src, bb.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT bb.session) AS c, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bb.event = 'order' THEN bb.session END) AS co FROM a JOIN bb ON bb.session = a.session AND bb.item <> a.item AND bb.seq > a.fq GROUP BY a.item, bb.item), sc AS (SELECT lt.session, pc.dst AS item, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * pc.c / (dn.tot + 2.0)) AS BIGINT) * (4 - lt.rp)) AS v, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * pc.co / (dn.tot + 2.0)) AS BIGINT) * (4 - lt.rp)) AS vo FROM lt JOIN pc ON pc.src = lt.item JOIN dn ON dn.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, pc.dst) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(sc.v AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_wk_after_buy_p, CAST(sc.vo AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_wk_after_ord_p FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;

name: wk_cos_rank
idea: Session-relative version of the strongest affinity signal: within-session rank of each candidate by the recency-weighted current-week co-visitation cosine from the last 5 distinct prefix items, and its ratio to the session's best value.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, rp FROM pr WHERE rp <= 5), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), pc AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), ns AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM a GROUP BY item), ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), nd AS (SELECT s.item, count(DISTINCT s.session) AS n FROM sess s JOIN ci ON ci.item = s.item GROUP BY s.item), q AS (SELECT lt.session, pc.dst AS item, lt.rp, pc.c / sqrt(CAST(ns.n AS DOUBLE) * CAST(nd.n AS DOUBLE)) AS cs FROM lt JOIN pc ON pc.src = lt.item JOIN ns ON ns.item = lt.item JOIN nd ON nd.item = pc.dst), g AS (SELECT session, item, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * cs) AS BIGINT) * (6 - rp)) AS sm FROM q GROUP BY session, item), j AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, g.sm FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item), r AS (SELECT session, item, sm, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY coalesce(sm, -1) DESC, item) AS rk, max(sm) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS mx FROM j) SELECT session, item, CASE WHEN sm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(rk AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_wk_cos_rk, CASE WHEN sm IS NULL OR mx IS NULL OR mx = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(sm AS DOUBLE) / CAST(mx AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_wk_cos_rel FROM r;

name: knn_hist_any
idea: Session kNN over 7-day history for any interaction: overlap-weighted count of neighbor history sessions (sharing at least 2 of the last 10 distinct prefix items) that touched the candidate at all, and its share of the session's total neighbor overlap, aimed at the next-view signal.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), si AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), df AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM si GROUP BY item), kq AS (SELECT si.session, si.item FROM si JOIN df ON df.item = si.item WHERE df.n <= 5000), nb AS (SELECT lt.session, kq.session AS ns, count(*) AS ov FROM lt JOIN kq ON kq.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, kq.session HAVING count(*) >= 2), tot AS (SELECT session, sum(ov) AS t FROM nb GROUP BY session), nq AS (SELECT DISTINCT ns FROM nb), ni AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item FROM hist x JOIN nq ON nq.ns = x.session WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), sc AS (SELECT nb.session, ni.item, sum(nb.ov) AS v FROM nb JOIN ni ON ni.session = nb.ns GROUP BY nb.session, ni.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(sc.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_knn_h_any, CASE WHEN sc.v IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (sc.v + 0.1) / (tot.t + 2.0) END AS ag_knn_h_any_sh FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.session = c.session;

name: p_centrality
idea: Intent centrality of prefix items: integer-exact sum of 14-day co-visitation cosine and of buy cosine from the item to the other last 20 distinct prefix items, so items at the core of the session's interest are separated from stray clicks.
sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), pt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 20), pp AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, b.item AS oi FROM pt a JOIN pt b ON b.session = a.session AND b.item <> a.item), cc AS (SELECT pp.session, pp.item, sum(CAST(round(c.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT)) AS v FROM pp JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = pp.item AND c.item2 = pp.oi GROUP BY pp.session, pp.item), bc AS (SELECT pp.session, pp.item, sum(CAST(round(b.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT)) AS v FROM pp JOIN tb_buy_cos14 b ON b.item = pp.item AND b.item2 = pp.oi GROUP BY pp.session, pp.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CASE WHEN pi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(cc.v, 0) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 END AS ag_p_cent_cos, CASE WHEN pi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(bc.v, 0) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 END AS ag_p_cent_bcos FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pi ON pi.session = c.session AND pi.item = c.item LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.session = c.session AND cc.item = c.item LEFT JOIN bc ON bc.session = c.session AND bc.item = c.item;

name: dwell_anchor
idea: Affinity to the prefix item the shopper spent the most time on (total capped dwell), via 14-day co-visitation cosine, an anchor distinct from the last, entry and most-clicked items.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.ts, lead(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item, x.event) AS nt FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, sum(CASE WHEN nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE least(nt - ts, 600) END) AS dw, max(seq) AS ls FROM s GROUP BY session, item), r AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY dw DESC, ls DESC, item) AS rk FROM g), d1 AS (SELECT session, item FROM r WHERE rk = 1), a AS (SELECT d1.session, c.item2 AS item, c.tv_cos AS v FROM d1 JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = d1.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, a.v AS ag_dwell_cos14 FROM cand c LEFT JOIN a ON a.session = c.session AND a.item = c.item;
